name: changestab
description: Read-only, session-workspace-scoped VCS file viewer for the dsh web GUI — its own Changes tab in the right column, alongside the built-in file browser (change tree nav, agent action chips, Open-in-Files handoff; generic connection.rpc host channel + web client).
author: American Jeff <gitjeff@americanjeff.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && node scripts/inject-css.mjs && node scripts/inject-icon.mjs && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsdown
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/containment.test.mjs && node test/magic.test.mjs && node test/filesystem.test.mjs && node test/host.test.mjs && node test/jj.test.mjs && node test/git.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs
